claim: Features: browse by folder or tags via TagLib (mp3, opus, flac, ape, m4a, wav), on-the-fly transcoding with ffmpeg, jukebox, podcasts, multiple users, last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling
Install from source, Docker or systemd; default login admin/admin
Initial scan of about 50k tracks takes about 10 minutes
Scan interval, scan at start and file watcher options; transcode cache size in MB
Tested clients include Symfonium, DSub, Amperfy
Multi-valued tags for genres, artists, album artists
Directory structure caveat: files from the same album in the same folder, all files in a folder from the same album
Web interface is for configuration (last.fm, users, scans)
